entry.title: Binance Founder CZ Talks Life Inside Prison, Trump Presidency, and the State of Crypto
entry.summary: In an exclusive interview, Rug Radio's Farokh Sarmad sits down with Changpeng Zhao, known by many as "CZ," Binance's founder and former CEO. They discuss CZ's time in jail, its hardships and lessons, his thoughts on the second Trump presidency, and how he's feeling about the crypto space in general.
